semantics.activeEasaAdvisory: Risk/advisory area; default route preview may suggest avoiding it
semantics.legalRestriction: Only from verified current NOTAM/AIP/regulatory source; not user-overridable in the planner
semantics.sanction: Not inferred from country or airline nationality; only apply where a current official source establishes a relevant restriction
semantics.missingData: Never invent a polygon, FIR code, prohibition or published procedure

limitations: This policy is for offline route-preview experiments, not operational flight planning.
The legacy airway graph is stale and its routes may be incomplete.
FIR boundary geometry and EASA advisory mapping are community/reference data and must be verified against current State AIPs and NOTAMs.
